title: Meta officials meet India's opposition Congress amid protests on content curbs: Report

ai.summary: Meta executives met Congress to address protests over content moderation and alleged bias toward the ruling BJP, as youth wing activists clashed with police near Meta offices in multiple cities.

facts.claim: Meta executives met Congress to address protests
facts.quote: Meta’s top executives in India held closed-door talks with the country’s opposition Congress party to defuse protests against the US firm’s content moderation practices, four people familiar with the matter said.

facts.claim: Youth Congress demanded account restoration and algorithm transparency
facts.quote: The Youth Congress has demanded that Meta restore accounts taken down on government orders and explain how its algorithms restrict posts

facts.claim: Protests involved clashes with police near Meta offices
facts.quote: its members have clashed with police near Meta’s offices in Hyderabad, Mumbai and Gurugram

facts.claim: Meta restricted 5.4 million posts/accounts in first half of 2026
facts.quote: Meta restricted more than 5.4 million posts or accounts under local laws in the first half of 2026, up from about 70,000 in all of 2025

facts.claim: Protesters used Zuckerberg posters in RSS uniform
facts.quote: posters and banners depicting Zuckerberg in a white shirt, khaki shorts and black cap, the traditional uniform of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS)

ai.background_note: Meta's content moderation practices in India have sparked protests, with youth activists demanding account restoration and algorithm transparency amid allegations of bias toward the ruling BJP.
